querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      pct_chg_recent1m,
                                      pct_chg_recent3m,
                                      pct_chg_recent6m,
                                      pct_chg_recent1y,
                                      pct_chg_recent2y,
                                      pct_chg_recent3y,
                                      pct_chg_recent4y,
                                      pct_chg_recent5y,
                                      pct_chg_recent6y,
                                      pct_chg_thisweek,
                                      pct_chg_thismonth,
                                      pct_chg_thisquarter,
                                      pct_chg_thisyear,
                                      si_pct_chg,
                                      annualyeild,
                                      std_dev_6m,
                                      std_dev_1y,
                                      std_dev_2y,
                                      std_dev_3y,
                                      sharpratio_6m,
                                      sharpratio_1y,
                                      sharpratio_2y,
                                      sharpratio_3y,
                                      pct_chg_recent1w,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_findexperformance.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.findexperformance WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
